skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand core concepts and theories of economic development, including classification of countries, economic and social characteristics of developing countries, and the essence and content of economic development.
Analyze and evaluate the economic development process of Vietnam and other developing countries using relevant data and models.
Apply critical thinking to assess economic growth, structural transformation, and social progress.
Develop research skills to independently study and accumulate knowledge, and to form professional ethics and social responsibility.
Communicate effectively in seminars and discussions, contributing to group learning and problem-solving.
Foster self-learning habits and continuous improvement in understanding economic development theories and practices.
